title: Warehouse updates retrying
summary: warehouse inventory transactions began deadlocking after a query rollout

logs: warehouse-db ERROR deadlock detected between update_stock and reserve_stock
deployments: v3.8 reversed table update order in reserve_stock

runbooks.title: Database deadlocks
runbooks.content: A deadlock spike after query-order changes requires consistent lock ordering and bounded retry behavior.

oracle.root_cause: v3.8 reversed lock order in reserve_stock, conflicting with update_stock transactions.
